discovery: The retained official BTCUSDT USD-M archive contains 64 consecutive May 2022 one-minute rows with quote_volume == 0 and trade_count == 0. Their timestamps and OHLC fields exist, but they contain no executable market activity.
causal_rule: A bar with nonpositive quote volume or nonpositive trade count is unavailable for this activity/impact strategy. It cannot contribute to a lag feature, signal, entry, stop path, capacity estimate or normal exit.
change: Retain the regular UTC timestamp grid but mark zero-activity bars unavailable.
Require every bar in the registered lag aggregation block to be activity-valid.
Require signal, entry, every intraposition bar and planned exit bar to be activity-valid.
Do not fill, compress or synthesize the unavailable interval.
reason_not_tuning: The correction follows from realistic execution and from the feature's dependence on actual trade count, quote volume and taker flow. It is independent of strategy family, threshold and observed PnL.
invalidated_output: All local candidate metrics computed before this correction are diagnostic only and excluded from registry, ranking and validation.
